description: Publish a static site or single-page app to a live HTTPS URL on the account's platform subdomain (e.g. {name}.vibedeploy.be). A new name creates the site. An existing name REPLACES EVERY FILE (files not in this call are deleted) and needs confirm:"I-want-to-replace-all-files"; preview with dryRun:true. Use update_site instead to change some files of an existing site. A 100-250 KB text file fits in this call with encoding:'gzip+base64' (gzip locally, then base64); use begin_deploy only when the files do not fit in one call. Ship a top-level 404.html for multi-page sites (otherwise unknown paths serve index.html) and use plain ASCII file names. Afterwards add_custom_domain can serve the site on the user's own domain.

confirm.description: Required when the site already exists: exactly "I-want-to-replace-all-files", confirming that every existing file is deleted and replaced. Omit for a new site.

dryRun.description: Validate and preview without writing; deletedFiles lists what would be removed. Recommended before replacing an existing site.

anyOf.description: Array form; needed for binary files.

content.description: File content: text, or base64 as set by encoding.

encoding.description: utf8 (default), base64 (binary files), or gzip+base64 (gzip locally, then base64; fits 3-5x more text per call).

path.description: Path relative to the site root, e.g. index.html or assets/app.js. Plain ASCII, no leading slash.

anyOf.description: Map form: path to UTF-8 text.

files.description: Either an array of {path, content, encoding?} entries OR a path->content map. Total payload <= 500 MB.

name.description: Site subdomain. Lowercase, 3-63 chars, alphanumeric + hyphens. Must not start or end with a hyphen.

name: deploy_site

created.description: True if this call created the site.

allowance.description: Custom domains the team's current plan includes.

connected.description: Custom domains on this site from both sources, one entry per hostname.

source.description: dashboard: linked on the dashboard Web Addresses page. mcp: added with add_custom_domain or the site API.

status.description: live: verified and serving this site. pending: linked, not verified yet.

nextTool.description: Present when this site has no custom domain yet and the team has room for one.

used.description: Distinct custom domains in use across the team, both sources (same count as get_account).

customDomains.description: Custom domains of this site and the team's custom-domain allowance; null when they could not be read. Omitted on dry runs.

customHeaders.description: Result of syncing the _headers file in the site root (site-wide /* response headers).

deletedFiles.description: Files that existed before this call and were removed by it. Empty for a new site.

dryRun.description: True on a dry run: nothing was written or deleted.

manageUrl.description: Dashboard page where the user manages this site (domains, versions, settings). Omitted on dry runs.

warnings.description: Non-blocking findings: DOTFILE_PUBLIC (a public .well-known file) or detected secrets such as API keys or JWTs.

title: Deploy a site (create or full-replace)
